label: PF Backlog 549
title: Epic execution-order persistence + epic/backlog lifecycle status (epic-status, backlog status, all-scopes)
body:
## Why
Follow-up to BI-PF-1222: the epic execution order was read-only and no view surfaced an epic/backlog lifecycle
(open/closed, groomed, needs-reanalysis, readiness, order).

## What
- epic_order(save=True) persists execution_order[] on the epic; children[] (membership) untouched.
- epic_status: ALL children (open+closed) with state/status/groomed/needs_reanalysis/ready/worker/wave/order_rank/
  order_status/reasons + rollup.
- backlog_status: per-epic rollups + standalone items for a scope; backlog_status_all aggregates every scope.

## Where
- API: POST /backlog/epics/{id}/order (save); GET /backlog/epics/{id}/status; GET /backlog/status[?all=true].
- CLI: /pf backlog epic-order <id> [--dry] (saves by default); epic-status <id>; status [--all].

## Verify
- test_scheduler_eligibility.py: save persists execution_order; epic_status open+closed+rollup; backlog_status rollup.
- Gates: scheduler_check, api_contract_check, pf_surface_check, lint (0 new).
